items.title: What are the major types of landforms and their significance to life and culture?
items.explanation: Landforms are physical features on Earth's surface that take shape over millions of years. They are broadly divided into three categories: mountains, plateaus, and plains. Each type has different climates and is home to varied flora and fauna. Humans have adapted to all landforms, but the number of people living on different kinds varies globally.

items.title: What are the challenges and opportunities of life associated with each landform?
items.explanation: The specific challenges and opportunities depend on the type of landform. For example, mountains offer high altitudes and snow-capped peaks but present challenges like cold temperatures and limited arable land for agriculture. Plains provide flat terrain ideal for farming and settlement, while plateaus offer elevated positions with distinct climates compared to surrounding areas.
